title: Coenraad van Beuningen to Gaspar Fagel, Westminster, 23 May/2 June 1676

steps.what: June cipher and glossed siblings transcribed; the volume inventory distinguishes glossed and unglossed letters.
Three key tables rebuilt from interlinear glosses in inv. 248–250.
Key applied to the June letter; contextual code proposals retained separately.
Spelled words of four or more letters: 93% Dutch versus 1.2% mean over 1,000 shuffled keys, maximum 11.6%.
First Codex review found overstatement and corrected blind-test accounting to M 10/10, I 3/6; clean blindness was not established.
Further glosses establish ondertusschen, genomen and mede; z108 corrected to z103; v274 conflict remains.
Second Codex review: 264/278 with gemelte; 263/278 excluding later hands; 265/278 only with selve and later-hand genomen. Same-code support 241/278.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Key rebuilt from the clerks' interlinear glosses of sibling letters in Nationaal Archief 3.01.18 inv. 248, 249 and 250, then applied to the unglossed June letter.
outcome.fraction_read_source: scripts/decode.py over transcription/june1676_tx.txt, key tables and corrections.tsv: 264/278 strict H+C+M with gemelte; 263/278 excluding later hands; 265/278 only with selve and later-hand genomen. Codex re-measure: codex_review/review2.md.

gaps.item: Twelve residual I tokens (c324, d210, e274, o211, p113, p122, s254, t218, v111, v274, w141, w204), plus g121 when gemelte is retained, and unread s439
gaps.detail: Context and alphabetical position do not establish these readings; s439 is in the sup- range.
Inventoried and still workable with the rebuilt key; no complete reading claimed.

outcome.notes: PARTIAL. Strict fractions are 94.96%, 94.60% and conditional 95.32%; same-code direct gloss support 241/278 (86.7%). Twelve residual I tokens and one unread s439 remain under selve; gemelte adds a thirteenth I token. Historical H/C/M/I bands are not repository-grade totals. Coverage does not establish coherent sense; mede remains awkward and v274 conflicts. No contemporary decipherment of this letter; controls were not rerun for this addition.

prior.where: First reading of the June letter; no contemporary decipherment. Sibling glosses are key evidence; historical summaries concern earlier correspondence.

human: Decipherment contributed by Feyseel Nur with Claude and Codex; the records preserve transcription, key reconstruction and two reviews. Exact division of the earlier work is not recorded.
